title: Sequence-slice scheduling + attention-window tiling + clock-steer experiments for H100/L40S
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: We observe 3-12% variance in tail latency and 8-20% token-cost differences across identical model versions when served on H100 vs L40S vs A10 with different MIG partitions and GPU clocks. Root causes appear to be suboptimal kernel selection for varying sequence lengths, attention kernel inefficiencies for long-context (>4k) slices, and contention when prefill/decode work is naively scheduled across multiple MIG stripes. Goal: Land a deterministic, low-risk set of changes that reduces 95th/99th latency variability, improves throughput for mid-long sequences, and yields consistent kernel selection across devices/clock regimes.
acceptance_criteria: 95th percentile latency reduced by >=8% for 4k-8k contexts on H100 with standard MIG partitions compared to baseline
Token throughput (tokens/sec) improved >=10% for L40S on mixed short/long workload after attention-window tiling and kernel registry heuristic changes
Automated microbench harness reproduces kernel-selection decision graph for each device/partition and is added to CI performance checks
No user-facing API changes and rollout via runtime-1.20 feature flag with canary gated to 5% traffic
tasks: Add per-device kernel-cost model entries for H100, L40S, A10 into kernel registry (Arjun)
Implement attention-window tiling when sequence>2048 to prefer blocked matmul+causal chunk kernels (engine change)
Create sequence-slice scheduler that assigns prefill slices to MIG stripes based on current clock governor and free-cycle budget
Instrument microbench harness to capture kernel selection path, per-kernel latency, and KV cache hit interplay (Maya)
Run 6x microbench matrix (devices x MIG configs x clock states) and upload artifacts to GCS
Add rollout plan (canary -> ramp) and pre-deploy rollback criteria to release playbook

experiment_results: H100 1xA100-style profile not representative: H100 shows best-case 12% throughput up on 4k contexts with tiling + kernel offsets
L40S shows 9-11% throughput improvements when clock governor is set to performance and sequence-slice scheduler avoids cross-MIG prefill stealing
A10 exhibits slight regression (~3% tokens/sec) on short-only workloads with tiling enabled; mitigation planned via thresholding (enable tiling only for seq>1024)
risks_and_mitigation: Regression on short-sequence latency: mitigate by conservative default (tiling threshold=1024) and feature-flag rollout
Memory pressure increase during tiling: add sampling profiler and limit concurrent tiled slices per GPU
Unexpected kernel mismatch under third-party driver versions: add CI microbench against driver matrix and fallback to stable kernel selection if mismatch detected
